rationale: Violent attack by Ukrainian national at Polish abbey killing a priest directly affects Polish security and social cohesion; Starlink sabotage continues as known threat.

top_events.title: Priest killed and four injured in knife attack at Polish abbey
top_events.label: Ukrainian suspect kills priest in Polish abbey attack
top_events.summary: A Ukrainian national killed a priest and injured four others in a knife attack at an abbey in Jarosław, Poland. The incident raises immediate security concerns and may strain Polish-Ukrainian relations amid ongoing refugee presence.

top_events.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
top_events.label: Poland confirms Starlink station fire was sabotage
top_events.summary: Polish government confirms sabotage at satellite station providing internet to Ukraine. Continues pattern of hybrid warfare threats on Polish infrastructure directly supporting Ukrainian war effort.

top_events.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
top_events.label: US court restores White House media access
top_events.summary: Federal judge orders restoration of press credentials for CNN, Politico, and MSNBC. Signals judicial check on executive power in key ally, relevant for democratic norms in NATO alliance.
